12505: São Francisco de Assis do Piauí

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 31/03/2026, em cerimônia presidida pela Câmara Municipal, depois que Igor Santos renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado federal na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on March 31, 2026, in a ceremony led by the City Council, after Mayor Igor Santos resigned to run for federal deputy in the 2026 election.
